title: Chilled Watermelon & Feta Soup
description: A refreshing chilled Continental soup made with fresh watermelon, cucumber, bell pepper, and mint, finished with crumbled feta and elegant garnishes. Perfect as a light appetizer or cold summer soup.

ingredients.title: For the Soup Base
items: Cucumber – ½ medium (peeled, deseeded, and chopped)

ingredients.title: For Garnish & Topping
items: Microgreens or baby basil – a few sprigs
Toasted pine nuts or pumpkin seeds – 1 tbsp (optional for crunch)
Balsamic reduction – a few drops (optional, for plating)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Base
steps: Combine watermelon cubes, cucumber, bell pepper, tomato, mint leaves, lime juice, and olive oil in a blender.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Season & Strain
steps: Taste and adjust salt and pepper.
Strain through a fine sieve for a velvety texture (for fine-dining presentation).

instruction.title: Step 3 – Chill
steps: Refrigerate the soup for at least 2–3 hours before serving.
Serve it ice-cold — this is key to its refreshing flavor.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Plating & Garnish
steps: Pour the chilled soup into chilled shallow bowls.
Garnish elegantly with crumbled feta, a few watermelon balls, microgreens, and toasted nuts.
Drizzle lightly with olive oil and a drop or two of balsamic reduction for contrast.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve ice-cold as an appetizer or cold summer soup.
Pair with a small brioche crisp or toasted baguette slice.

chefTips: Use very ripe watermelon for natural sweetness — no need for added sugar.
A hint of chili or pink peppercorn adds an exciting gourmet twist.
Serve with a small brioche crisp or toasted baguette slice on the side.
